summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Hanfu Production p01 - Hair Pattern Import and Export ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore the process of creating a Hanfu hairstyle using Marvelous Designer. This video focuses on the steps involved in making a simple hairstyle and the technical adjustments required to achieve the desired effect. ## Creating the Hairstyle To match the effect of Hanfu, I first made a simple hairstyle with a version of the original design. I used a stabilizer to fix the hairstyle close to the head and then copied a layer to serve as the outer layer of the hair. ### Outer Layer Adjustments The outer layer of the hair should be larger to allow for inflation and to create a bulge like a hair bun. To increase the bending strength of this panel, I reduced the wrinkles to make the fabric more flexible. - **Adjusting Fabric Properties**: - Reduce the strength of the gold tail sand and the corner line sand. This adjustment is necessary because the fabric is more stretched, allowing for greater expansion after inflation. - Increase the pressure of the outer layer to 50, ensuring that the hair bag can inflate properly. ## Shaping the Hair Bag The principle of shaping the hair bag involves dividing a rectangular panel into two sides. The bending strength needs to be increased to 100 because the fabric is very hard, making it difficult to collapse and helping to form a tube shape. ### Panel Selection After creating the panel, select all the panels that form the hair in the window of the second level. Ensure to select the items that are chosen by DolbingJ. This will allow you to unangle all selected items to OBJ format. ## Unangling Options In the selection process, the couple setting is crucial. You can choose to unangle all items as multiple targets or unangle one at a time. ### Unangling Settings - When unangling, you can choose whether it contains thickness. - In the previous choice, you may opt not to tackle thickness during the flight. - You can also choose to align the line along the line or parallel to the board. ### Effects of Different Settings - **First Setting**: For multiple targets, this offset setting causes the boards to be independent of each other within one area, resulting in no grid on the back side and no overall thickness. - **Second Setting**: This also applies to multiple targets; however, the thickness will be offset. The boards will remain independent of each other with no overall thickness. - **Third Setting**: The boards will be divided into different types of fabrics, each grouped into one area. When there is a seam line between the boards, the two sides will align at the top of the seam line. ## Combination Options The combination option can only be applied when selecting thin thickness. For example, if thickness is thin when selecting one target, the combination can be eliminated. - After the combination is eliminated, a seam line will run throughout the board, but the boards will no longer coincide at the top. - When you choose to represent thickness, you cannot select the combination option due to the grid present on each board's side. ## Working with Hair Textures Open HANA to view the hair, which will be transformed into a virtual model. The selection of the loading type will be increased after selecting the hair. ### Positioning and Color Adjustments Using the positioning ball, you can move or transform the hair's position. After displaying the texture, you will notice that the side texture from the previous version has disappeared. In the current version, the side grid does not have UV mapping, leading to a loss of texture clarity. - **Setting Temporary Colors**: Let's temporarily set the side texture to a single color and adjust the rest of the components accordingly. - **Final Color Selection**: Now select the hair and change its color to the desired shade. Adjust the side and hair colors to match. At first, I will apply the same technique as before. Next, select the hair and adjust the color to the selected shade. During the selection process, the color may change unexpectedly based on the selected properties. Let's finalize the color adjustments. ```
